summary: Generated 4 P0 Rust API replay tests. Each seed checks 128 completed transactions ([26,26,26,25,25] destinations), 9 reset cancellations ([2,2,2,2,1]), request stalls, 17-64 cycle leaf waits and seeded response stalls. Oracle compares all handshake outputs each cycle and only valid payloads. Native engines and real emitted RTL replay identical input/expected trace. Artifacts reuse common::dir/run and write per-seed coverage.json plus trace, bench, emitted design and tool logs under target/fr196-decoder-integration/. Existing shared fixtures unchanged; no tests run, no process docs edited, no product changes. Pre-aggregation correction: asserted leaf responses use only error 0/2/3; failed reads have zero rdata, failed writes permit arbitrary rdata. Invalid leaf error/data noise remains arbitrary. Added actual completed read/write-by-error counters to coverage.json and require both operation classes to exercise 0/2/3, with no reserved error 1. Tests remain unrun.
